verdict.rationale: Unity ships a built-in AI Assistant (docs-24) that lets users delegate tasks like asset creation, workflow automation, performance analysis, and project actions via natural-language prompts, backed by a metered credits system (docs-14) confirming it's a real, in-product feature rather than a roadmap item. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration of the Assistant's real-world reliability, and more detail on the scope/limits of delegated tasks.
